chars.BOY: BOY: a shy Moroccan young man about 20, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a grey work t-shirt dusted with silver aluminium shavings and dark navy work trousers
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Moroccan woman about 19, light blonde hair partly under a loose pastel pink headscarf, blue eyes, wearing a long lilac house djellaba with white embroidery

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from just behind the young man's shoulder at the open front door of a modest Moroccan family house in Mohammedia: GIRL steps out of the doorway holding a covered clay tagine lunch dish toward him, looking straight at him with a curious little smile, face fully visible, head-to-waist framing. Warm afternoon light, tiled entrance, calm plain background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the house door: BOY stands stiff and embarrassed, eyes lowered, cheeks flushed, taking the lunch dish with both hands, while GIRL in the doorway tilts her head and watches him, amused. Medium shot, both faces visible, Moroccan house entrance with green tiles.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of BOY standing at a house doorway staring hard at the floor tiles, holding a covered lunch dish, sweating nervously, awkward shy expression, face visible from a slightly low angle. Soft blurred doorway behind him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: GIRL leans on the door frame of the family house, smiling and chatting to BOY who stands on the doorstep shyly glancing up at her, holding a lunch dish. She gestures lightly with one hand as she talks. Medium shot, both faces visible, Moroccan street door, afternoon light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOY finally lifts his eyes and looks at GIRL at the house doorway; she greets him with a warm shy smile, hand on her chest. Their eyes meet, a tender awkward moment. Medium two-shot, faces visible, warm golden light, Moroccan house entrance.
